b'# tinydl

A small command line downloader. It fetches a URL and writes the bytes to a
file or to stdout, retrying failed attempts a few times.

## Usage

    python -m app.cli [options] url

## Command line options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `url` | what to download (positional argument) |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

## Examples

    # Download to stdout
    python -m app.cli https://example.com/file.bin

    # Download to a file, without progress output
    python -m app.cli -q -o file.bin https://example.com/file.bin
'
